# FanumTag v1.2.0

FanumTag is a local-first Windows workspace for generating descriptive filenames
without uploading personal media.

## Highlights

- Local Qwen3-VL image and meme captioning that prioritizes visible text and uses
  recognizable character identities when possible.
- Image, video, audio, and text queues with thumbnails, filtering, pagination,
  selection tools, progress reporting, cancellation, and safe bulk renaming.
- Configurable Qwen and MMProj `.gguf` paths under **Settings → Runtime Settings**.
- Persisted runtime auto-start and health checks for local inference dependencies.
- Critical shutdown fix: closing FanumTag now terminates its managed llama-server,
  FFmpeg, and Whisper child processes instead of leaving them running.

## Windows installation

A complete packaged download has this layout:

```text
FanumTag-windows-x64/
├── fanumtag_1.2.0_x64-setup.exe
└── weights/
    ├── Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf-00001-of-00002.gguf
    ├── Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf-00002-of-00002.gguf
    └── mmproj-F16.gguf
```

Keep the installer beside `weights` and run it from that folder. Setup verifies all
three model files and copies them into the installed application. After installation,
leave **Qwen Model Path** and **MMProj Model Path** empty to use the bundled defaults.
For another compatible sharded Qwen model, select its first shard and keep all shards
together.

The complete packaged distribution is approximately 3.44 GiB. This release is being
published without rebuilding the deleted Windows build output, so GitHub currently
provides source archives only. Those automatic source archives do not contain the
Git-ignored native runtime or model weights.

## Validation status

- Version metadata resolves to `1.2.0` in npm, Cargo, and Tauri configuration.
- The shutdown implementation is attached to Tauri's final application exit event
  and synchronously terminates all tracked child processes.
- The prior packaged runtime and sharded Qwen/MMProj model were validated before the
  build output was removed.
- No new Windows bundle was built for this source release.
